name: Bootstrap Process Manager
description: PID 1 entrypoint that manages Caddy gateway and Streamlit portal, auto-restarts crashed services

name: Heartbeat Cycle Runner
description: Single-cycle execution engine triggered via docker exec; loads memory, executes prompts via Claude SDK

name: Caddy Gateway
description: HTTP reverse proxy on port 8080; routes to Streamlit, file browser, and static files; dynamic reconfiguration via admin API

name: Streamlit app portal
description: Multi-tab Streamlit app portal at /app/ with hot-reload; dashboard, chat, and grouped feature tabs

name: Memory Persistence
description: JSON-based persistent memory system (state, cycles, journal, goals); survives container restarts

name: Message Queue
description: Inbox/outbox message passing for goals, messages, and human-needs-input signals

name: Prompt Selection Engine
description: Automatic prompt routing based on agent state: bootstrap, self-heal, goal execution, or evolution

name: File Browser
description: Caddy-served file browser at /_/ for browsing agent filesystem with download links

name: Portal Configuration
description: Unified portal configuration for hostname (public Cloudflare Tunnel URL), timezone, and HTTP basic auth; replaces legacy portal-hostname and portal-auth scripts

name: Cycle Start Briefing
description: Startup briefing combining memory repair, state summary, recent journal, inbox peek, and evolve recommendation

name: Cycle Close Automation
description: Auto-close cycles by updating state, marking completion with duration, appending journal entry

name: Memory Repair
description: Detects and auto-repairs corrupted JSON memory files; restores from backups or safe defaults

name: Memory Backup
description: Timestamped snapshots of critical memory files; supports restore and pruning (keeps max 20)

name: Journal Archival
description: Archives old journal entries (>20 cycles) to keep active journal lean for fast loading

name: Memory Sync
description: Generates .md auto-memory files from JSON memory data (state, capabilities, goals); makes memory accessible to the agent's memory system

name: Long-Term Memory Ingest
description: Bulk-ingests journal, cycle, and goal data into a memvid .mv2 semantic memory index; supports incremental append and raw text/file ingestion

name: Long-Term Memory Recall
description: Queries the memvid .mv2 semantic memory index; retrieves past cycle experiences, related historical work, and chronological timeline browsing

name: Memory Q&A
description: RAG-powered natural-language Q&A over memvid .mv2 long-term memory; retrieves adaptive context then synthesizes answers via Claude

name: Long-Term Memory Inspector
description: Read-only diagnostics for the memvid .mv2 index: on-disk footprint (file + sibling artifacts), frame/entry counts, source/label/tag/preview-length distributions, timestamp span, and a comparison against source JSON files (journal, journal archive, inbox history) to spot inflation from auto-chunking or stale records

name: Hybrid Full-Text Search
description: Two-stage hybrid search (scripts/search.py): ripgrep does a fast exact-match pre-filter to discover candidate files, then BM25S indexes each one and produces a globally re-ranked list of relevance-scored snippets across /agent (memory/, messages/, web/, workspace/, scripts/, prompts/) and any other repo path. Large files (>100 KB) get cached on-disk indices rebuilt only when source mtime changes; supports --dir scoping, --top N, --no-rg (catalog-only), --json, --rebuild-all, --list-catalog, --reset-catalog. Exposed to the agent via the 'search' skill

name: Memory Stats Summary
description: Fast cycle-start status summary that reads all key memory files and prints a concise structured report (text/JSON/--short) so future cycles don't have to open multiple files manually

name: Inbox History Archive
description: Centralized inbox ingestion plus archival of drained inbox messages to inbox_history.json; preserves mid-cycle messages via timestamp-based partitioning and feeds long-term memory ingest at cycle_close

name: Dream Cycle
description: Dedicated cycle type with memory_consolidation and deep_sleep categories that runs in a configured night window (00:00–08:00 local TZ); integrates <24h dream learnings/topics into cycle output and skips consecutive dreams to keep daytime cycles productive

name: KeePass Credential Manager
description: Local KeePass database for API keys, passwords, and secrets; CLI get/store/list/search; imported directly by services to avoid subprocess spawns

name: Chat Interface
description: Claude SDK chat UI with streaming responses (fragment-based), tool use display, bounded execution via --agent-timeout, and persistent history; chat history and SDK session files live under the unified /agent/memory/chat/<surface>/ layout (history, archive, <surface>.session) with automated migration from legacy paths

name: Telegram Bridge
description: Bridges inbox/outbox with a Telegram bot; polls for incoming messages, forwards outbox to Telegram, auto-discovers chat ID; supports /remind, /note, /notes, /status, /goals, /services commands; writes heartbeat for liveness monitoring

name: WhatsApp Bridge
description: Bridges inbox/outbox with WhatsApp Business Cloud API; registered as a sub-handler of webhook_receiver on path /whatsapp-bridge (external URL: /webhook/whatsapp-bridge). Forwards outbox to WhatsApp every 60s and auto-discovers owner phone. Credentials in KeePass: WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN, WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID, WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN

name: CallMeBot Voice Escalation
description: Voice call escalation via CallMeBot Telegram API; calls the human when a needs_human outbox message goes unanswered; credentials stored in KeePass

name: Internal Agent Chat Daemon
description: Headless daemon hosting one long-lived claude_agent_sdk session per registered internal agent in agents.json. File-based messaging only (no HTTP): senders drop envelopes into /agent/messages/internal/<name>/inbox.json; daemon archives drained envelopes, persists per-agent transcripts under /agent/memory/chat/<name>/, and routes outbound messages via a per-session send_reply MCP tool whose recipient set is shaped by agents.json outbox_routing_rules. Supports clear_chat / clear_session control flags and agents.json hot-reload on each 10s sweep

name: Register Internal Agent
description: CLI to add/update/remove internal-agent entries in agents.json and seed per-agent inbox/outbox/chat files; supports OPTIONAL per-agent system_prompt appended to the shared base prompt and outbox_routing_rules to constrain LLM-chosen recipients

name: Register External Agent
description: CLI to add/update external-agent entries in agents.json and seed empty per-agent inbox/outbox files at /agent/messages/external/<name>/; accepts responsibilities, capabilities (file or inline JSON), and an optional timeout; supports --list, --deactivate, and --setup operational subcommands

name: Operator Agent CLI
description: Operator CLI for runtime maintenance of registered agents — clear-chat (archive then wipe chat history), clear-session (reset SDK resume thread), and send-message (atomic, locked, optionally-deduped envelope append) for any internal/external agent or the reserved 'main'. Mutating ops queue control flags read by the internal_agent_chat daemon on its next sweep

name: External Agent API
description: HTTP service on port 8083 (routed at /external-agent/* via Caddy with basic auth) that lets registered external agents talk to the main agent via per-agent inbox/outbox files at /agent/messages/external/<name>/. Routes: read-inbox, write-outbox, ping, update (patch status/capabilities/responsibilities; status=deactivated halts forwarding). Background sweeper drains each agent's outbox into /agent/messages/inbox.json with source=external_agent and reply_to=<inbox path>. Registry at memory/agents.json.

name: Email IMAP Client
description: IMAP email client supporting any provider; fetch, search, delete, and verify emails using credentials from KeePass (entry 'Email IMAP' with server URL, username, and app password)

name: Metrics Collector
description: Time-series metrics for Streamlit response time, CPU, memory, and disk usage

name: Self-Test Suite
description: Comprehensive test suite validating API endpoints, memory files, disk health, processes, and imports

name: Health Check
description: Multi-service health check with retry logic for Streamlit and Caddy endpoints

name: App Render Check
description: Headless AppTest framework catching syntax errors, missing imports, and runtime exceptions

name: Cycle Reporting
description: Summary reports of agent activity showing recent cycles with duration, type, and category

name: Milestone Reporting
description: Narrative growth snapshots at significant cycle intervals (25, 50, 75, 100...)

name: Transcript Filter & Renderer
description: Walks /agent/memory/transcripts/cycle-*.jsonl, filters by time window, and emits paths, paginated streamlined Markdown (user prompts, assistant text/thinking, tool calls/results — not raw JSON), or JSON arrays. Caches results and supports --no-thinking, --page-size, --page navigation, and explicit FILES... mode

name: Current Date/Time Helper
description: Reports the current date/time in the user's configured timezone (sourced from portal_config.json, falls back to UTC); supports human-readable and JSON output for use by prompts and skills

name: Auto Maintenance
description: Memory validation, journal archival, log cleanup, zombie process detection, and disk usage reporting

name: Scheduler Daemon
description: Long-running service that polls scheduled_tasks.json every 30s and atomically injects due tasks into inbox.json independent of heartbeat cycles; writes a heartbeat file so health checks can surface daemon failures; managed by service_manager with auto_start=true

name: Reminder Manager
description: Create and manage personal reminders that fire as inbox messages via the scheduler; supports one-time (--at), recurring (--every N minutes), and cron-based (--cron) reminders

name: Service Manager
description: Manages long-running background services (optional port 8082-8090); start, stop, restart, status, health-check (with heartbeat staleness detection), list, and cleanup; atomic state files prevent concurrent corruption

name: Webhook Receiver
description: Generic HTTP webhook handler on port 8082; records POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE payloads to webhook.json; Caddy routes /webhook/* to this service; managed via service-manager

name: Agent Browser
description: Headless Chromium automation via agent-browser CLI for web interaction and scraping

name: Skill Creator
description: Create new skills from scratch, modify and improve existing skills, run evals, and benchmark skill performance with variance analysis and triggering accuracy optimization

name: Notes Manager
description: Personal notes and scratchpad; add, list, search, edit, delete, tag, pin, export (Markdown/JSON), and view stats; importable as a Python module by services for direct in-process note creation

name: Workspace File Upload
description: Upload files from local machine to /agent/workspace/ via portal with subdirectory support

name: Command Center
description: Portal tab for sending goals/messages, running scripts, and browsing command history

name: Memory Viewer
description: Portal tab for browsing journal, logs, goals, and memory files with cross-file search

name: System Diagnostics
description: Portal tab for health checks, error tracking, validation, services, and script inventory

name: Overview Dashboard
description: Portal tab with suggestions, goal performance, evolution balance, and activity summary
